description: This file provides utility functions for resolving the correct pnpm command and spawning pnpm process instances, with platform-specific handling for Windows and environment variable management.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Determines the appropriate command and arguments to run pnpm based on the environment and parameters.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a spawn specification object suitable for spawning a pnpm process with specified parameters.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a pnpm process using Node's child_process.spawn with configured parameters.
